description: This file defines a RetryPolicy class that provides retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter, intended for use when making network requests or other potentially failing asynchronous operations.

classes.name: RetryPolicy
classes.description: A helper class implementing retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter, configurable via constructor parameters.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous operation with retries until success or maximum attempts are reached, applying exponential backoff between attempts.
